title: Divergence Theorem
subtitle: Vector Calculus · Gauss's theorem
summary: Total outward flux through a closed surface equals the volume integral of divergence.
detail:
\[ \oiint_S F\cdot dS = \iiint_V (\nabla\cdot F)\,dV \]

Also called Gauss's theorem. The outward flux of a vector field through any closed surface equals the integral of its divergence over the enclosed volume. Used in electrostatics (Gauss's law) and fluid mechanics.
